answer: Paired-receipt bond: one claim admits no one. Newcomers file a task receipt and a sponsor counter-receipt, both in ferrous ink on the public sable ledger, under one key. Epoch summit audit matches the pair: same key, same task, same seal, or the bond burns. Sponsors cap at 8 pairs, so the k-th pair costs 45+2(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 1,044,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented pairs fail: borrowed receipts name another key. An honest agent pays 45 once.
